tei:div.tei:p: ༈ sems nyid rang grol gyi gsol 'debs bzhugs/

skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ nam mkha'i gnas su nam mkha' gang ba yi/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang*/ /sangs rgyas chos dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la/ /bdag dang 'gro drug gus pas skyabs su mchi/ /sems bskyed pa ni/ mgon po sras dang bcas rnams dgongs/ /ji ltar dus gsum rgyal ba rnams/ /byang chub thug ni bskyed pa ltar/ /de bzhin 'gro la phan don du/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing*/ /ji ltar gsungs pa'i bslab pa la/ /rim pa bzhin du legs slob cing*/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal kun bsal te/ /ci byas gzhan don 'grub par shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐/ / chos sku kun bzang yab yum la gsol ba 'debs/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐/ /longs sku snang mtha' yab yum la gsol ba 'debs/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐/ /sprul sku o rgyan yab yum la gsol ba 'deb/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra= /rgyal sras dri med 'od zer la= /oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra= /mkhas grub bde legs rgya mtsho la= /oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra= /bya btang ma ti maṅga la= /oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra= byang sems gu ṇa shrī la= /oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra= sprul sku bsam grub rgyal po la= /oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra= 'khrul zhig nam mkha' gzhon nu la= /oṃ āḥhūm̐badzra= rgyal sras chos dbyings rdo rje la= /oṃ āḥhūm̐badzra= mkhas grub blo gros rgyal mtshan la= /oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra= drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la= /oṃ āḥhūm̐= yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐= bka' srung mkha' 'gro chos skyong la= /oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra= bla ma rin po che bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sbrib pa byang zhing*/ sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob nas tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ye shes gangs can mtsho las lhun gyis grub pa'i rang bzhin/

rgyal sras padma 'byung gnas kyi zhabs kyi padmo dri ma med pa la dus gsum thams cad du phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /brtse ba chen pos rjes su bzung du gsol/ mgon po gdod nas rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bde chen yon tan 'byung ba'i mdzod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bla ma mchog /kun bzang yab yum la phyag 'tshal/ /rigs lnga ye shes lnga yi dngos/ /rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bo nyid/ /zhi dang khro tshul dpag med ston/ /snang mtha' yab yum la phyag 'tshal/ /bde gshegs rgya mtsho'i rnam 'phrul las/ /rang byung ge sar padma'i steng*/ /mtshan rdzogs dpe byad 'bar ba'i sku/ /padma 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal/ /ngo bo ye nas nas kun tu bzang*/ /rang bzhin bde gshegs 'od dpag med/ /thug rje padmar sku sprul pa/ /shākya seng ge la phyag 'tshal/ /sku gsum mdzad pa'i 'phrin las kyis/ /gdul bya'i re ba rnams skong zhing*/ /mkha' 'gro 'bar ba'i sprin 'phro ba/ padma rgyal po la phyag 'tshal/ /ji snyid ji bzhin thams cad mkhyen/ /sna tshogs chos kyi rnga sgra yis/ /bdud dang mu stegs tshar gcod pa/ /blo ldan mchog sred la phyag 'tshal/ /kun mkhyen ye shes gangs ri la/ /rnam grol mchog gi go 'phang brnyes/ /dpag med 'khor gyi tshogs nang du/ /seng ge'i sgra sgrogs la phyag 'tshal/ /thugs rje'i char sprin rol pa las/ /phan bde'i glog phreng char 'bebs shing*/ /'gro blo'i phun tshogs rgyas byed pa/ /padma sambha la phyag 'tshal/ /mkhyen brtse'i 'od stong dkyil 'khor gyis/ /gsung rab padmo rgyas mdzad cing*/ /'gro ba'i lam yang dkar po mdzad/ /nyi ma 'od zer la phyag 'tshal/ /rnam 'phrul drag pos 'dul ba la/ /'jigs rung gar dgu'i nyams ldan zhing*/ /lha srin gdug pa tshar gcod pa'i/ /padma thod phreng la phyag 'tshal/ /mkha' 'gro 'bar ba'i sprin phung las/ /dngos grub bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs shing*/ /bde chen rgyal ba mnyes mdzad yum/ /mkhar chen mtsho rgyal la phyag 'tshal/

/shes bya'i dkyil 'khor rab gzigs shing*/ /dam chos rin chen mdzod 'dzin pas/ /zab mo'i dgongs gter rgyas mdzad pa/ /dri med 'od zer la phyag 'tshal/ /lta spyod zung du 'jug pa yis/ /rig 'dzin mchog gi dngos grub brnyes/ /bla med snying po'i bstan pa 'dzin/ /bde legs rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal/ /bstan pa'i gdung 'dzin 'gro ba'i yab/ /rtogs pa phul phyin byang sems ldan/ / 'gro rnams smin grol lam la 'god/ /ma ti maṅga la phyag 'tshal/ /sngon sbyangs smon lam stobs chen gyis/ /stong nyid snying rje'i don rtogs nas/ / 'gro kun brtse bas 'dren pa'i dpal/ /gu ṇa shrī la= /mdo rgyud dgongs pa thugs chud cing*/ /bslab gsum gyis brgyan rtogs pa 'bar/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i snying po 'dzin/ /sprul sku bsam rgyal la= /rnal grol chos dbyings mnyam nyid dang*/ /zag med ye shes 'od gsal mchog /nyin dang mtshan mo dbyer med pa'i/ /nam mkha' gzhon nu la= /gdod nas lhun grub chos sku'i ngang*/ /gzugs skur rol pa sgyu ma'i sku/ /sna tshogs thabs ldan 'gro kun sgrol/ /mkha' klong yangs pa la= /stong nyid zab mo 'di nyid la/ /mi shes rang blos bcings pa kun/ /ye shes rig pa'i ral gris gcod/ /ma ti dhwa dza la= /sngon sbyang stobs chen las 'phro yis/ /bla med rdo rje snying po'i don/ / 'bad rtsol med pa lhun gyis grub/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma la phyag 'tshal/ /ngang nyid chos dbyings rol pa las/ /sna tshogs thabs kyi rnam 'phrul gyis/ /phrin las rnam bzhis las mdzad pa/ /mkha' 'gro dam can la= /gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i rig 'dzin dang*/ /bde gshegs chos dang 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /mkha' 'gro bde chen rgya mtsho dang*/ /mchod 'os kun la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /dge'o// memes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (22) sems nyid rang grol gyi gsol 'debs/ - PAGE 408 -- PAGE 409 - - PAGE 407
